                                SUBSTITUTE ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-G in the area bounded by;

              The public alley next north and parallel to West 69"' Street; a line 125.00 feet east
              of and parallel to South Bishop Street; West 69* Street; and a line 75.00 feet east
              of and parallel to South Bishop Street

to those of an B3-2 Community Shopping District.

SECTION. 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 1414 - 16 West 69"' Street
                                                                          W l FCK FUBUGAI'IOM


                                     Amended To Be A Type-1
                                        Narrative and Plans
                                     Zoning Map Amendment
                                      at 1416 West 69th Street
                                          from RS3 to B3-2


Narrative: The Property contains 6,240 square feet of land and is improved with an existing two-
story building with ground floor commercial space and a residential dwelling unit on the upper
floor, with one parking space. The Applicant proposes to re-use the existing building and build
two-story addition thereto. The building will be used for ground floor and second floor commercial
space, including a 1,050 square foot coffee shop on the ground floor and offices on the ground and
second floors. Five surface parking spaces will be provided. The proposed height is 25.5 feet.



Lot Area:                     6,240 square feet
